name: com.skymavis.axiemixer3d.weaponanims
description: Optional weapon/action animation clips for Axie Mixer 3D. Install alongside com.skymavis.axiemixer3d and register the catalog with the AxieFactory (via AxieWeaponAnims.Register or the AxieWeaponAnimInitializer component) to enable weapon actions such as AxeAttack, BowSkill, and CannonWalk.
